scientific_integrity: Explicit exact algebra, derivative-based Hopf calculation and reproducible symbolic checker; earlier behavior-induced epidemic cycles acknowledged. No independent validation or certified uniqueness claim.
scientific_limitations: Local bifurcation relative to the synchronous three-community invariant manifold; no global or transverse stability claim. Nondegenerate opposite-sign witnesses are proved using the classical Hopf theorem. Literature coverage not claimed exhaustive.
title: Opposite Hopf criticalities in a triadic SIS–opinion model
